ios.desc:
Storage Buddy helps you remember where you put the things you do not use every day.

Spare keys. Warranty papers. Tool kits. Travel adapters. Seasonal decorations. Camera gear. Old documents. Cables. Craft supplies. Storage boxes.

Add an item once with its photo, category, notes, and exact location, then find it later with search, visual browsing, filters, or smart suggestions.

WHAT YOU CAN TRACK

• Items stored at home, office, garage, attic, closets, drawers, shelves, or storage units
• Boxes, bins, drawers, travel cubes, and containers
• Keys, tools, cables, documents, electronics, seasonal items, hobby gear, kitchen items, travel gear, and more
• Rarely used things you need to find quickly later

WHY PEOPLE USE STORAGE BUDDY

• Remember exactly where something is stored
• Stop opening every drawer or box to find one item
• Add photos for visual recognition
• Organize items by room, shelf, drawer, box, or container
• Search by name, notes, category, or location
• Browse items visually by storage location
• Keep track of item history and location changes
• Clean up clutter with smart inventory suggestions
• Back up and restore your inventory

POWERFUL INVENTORY FEATURES

• Add item names, categories, photos, notes, and custom details
• Save exact storage locations
• Group items into containers such as boxes, bins, drawers, shelves, and travel cubes
• Search and browse your inventory
• Use Visual Inventory to see items by location
• Mark important items as favorites
• Review item history and audit logs
• Bulk edit, bulk move, and bulk reassign categories
• Export backups and CSV files
• Restore from backup with import preview
• View stats and insights about your stored items
• Find items missing photos
• Review possible duplicates
• Identify crowded locations and stale inventory
• Customize layout options

USE IT FOR

• Spare keys
• Important documents
• Tools and repair kits
• Chargers, cables, adapters, and electronics
• Seasonal decorations
• Holiday storage boxes
• Attic, garage, closet, and pantry items
• Travel gear and packing cubes
• Camping gear
• Craft supplies
• Memorabilia and collections
• Office supplies and archived files
• Kitchen tools and rarely used appliances

Storage Buddy is local-first and designed for everyday people who want a simple, visual way to remember where things are stored.

Download Storage Buddy and build a searchable memory for your home, office, or storage space.

quotes.text:
This app helps you remember where you stored anything that isn’t part of your daily routine — at home, in the office, or even in storage.

You can:

* Add items with names, categories, and descriptions

* Record where each item is stored

* Snap a photo to visually remember it

* Easily search and browse your stored items.

Use it for things like:

* Spare keys (gate, garage, old house)

* Seasonal decorations or winter gear

* Rarely-used documents

* Tools, cables, and electronics

* Items stored in attic, boxes, or storage units

* Craft supplies, collections, or hobby gear

* Office items or archived files

* Travel adapters, backpacks, camping gear

This is a free app with IAP to remove ads.

Appreciate any feedback or suggestions.
